title: PowerShell terminal duplicates lines when resized
symptom_summary: Existing output lines appear twice after expanding and collapsing the integrated terminal view.
repro_steps: Print more lines than the visible area.
Expand and collapse the terminal view several times.

title: Integrated terminal does not display typed characters
symptom_summary: The integrated terminal shows a blinking cursor, but typing produces no visible characters. The external Command Prompt accepts input.
repro_steps: Open the integrated terminal on a fresh VS Code installation.
Try to type a command such as dir.

title: Integrated terminal fails to launch after updating to 1.109.0
symptom_summary: Opening the integrated terminal on Windows 10 LTSB 2016 fails after an update or fresh installation of VS Code 1.109.0.
repro_steps: Install or update to VS Code 1.109.0.

title: Integrated terminal receives repeated Enter input after update
symptom_summary: After restarting VS Code for an update, the integrated terminal behaves as if Enter is being pressed repeatedly, preventing normal use.
repro_steps: Restart VS Code to complete the update.
Observe input in the integrated terminal.
